scope: Text and SourceText byte intrinsic inside interpolation: canonical receiver representation and checked byte access.
CSharp: LlvmEmitter Flow handles canonical RuntimeText/RuntimeSourceText after reference normalization; evaluates UIntSize index once, compares ult i64 against length, emits terminal trap before byte load. Current focused5/5 normal outputs pass before SLG edit.
SLG: emitInterpolationIntrinsic opcode-202 gates on interpolationBindingIndex. It extracts receiver field0 using binding raw type without loading ref values, omits current length/guard and assumes an i64 subscript. This skips computed Text receivers and attempts extractvalue ptr for readonly inputs. Existing transient/deferred and subtree callers delegate here.
actualBefore: Three native normal cases pass but byte loads have no bounds checks. Readonly Text/SourceText fails LLVM extractvalue ptr; computed slice receiver fails undefined byte-result SSA. Both failed builds retained once; no failed executable run or repeat.
decision: Normalize receiver through interpolationNodeTypeId; unwrap/load readonly references once, accept canonical computed receiver, extract data/current length from canonical Text/SourceText carrier. Normalize UIntSize index to i64 once and reuse a common trap-before-access helper shared with C695 arrays. Keep C695 ordinary outcomes and unchanged mapped/index/dictionary paths.
